name: dsh-release-guardian
description: Local, deterministic release-risk checks for Git changes: secrets, dangerous edits, CI risk, and missing verification.

commit_gate.title: Scan before git commit
commit_gate.description: Run a read-only scan of the changes a `git commit` would record and deny the commit on a block verdict. Advisory only: any scan failure allows the commit.

cli_path.title: Release Guardian CLI path
cli_path.description: Path to an existing dsh-release-guardian lib/cli.js. Leave empty to use the build bundled with the plugin, or an installation on PATH.
